newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Chrysler signs $40 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Thai Chrysler signs $40 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Thai Chrysler Automotive Ltd signed a $40 million syndicated revolving credit facility to finance import duties and meet working capital requirements, its loan arranger Citicorp Investment Bank (Singapore) Ltd said on Wednesday.
Citicorp said in a statement Thai Chrysler, an affiliate of Chrysler Corp of U.S., signed a loan agreement with five banks managing the loan and another five co-managers in Singapore last Friday.
The facility's managers were Bank of Montreal, Citibank Finance Ltd, ING Bank Thailand, Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd and Kredietbank NV.
Citicorp said the Thai Chrysler's loan facility was over-subscribed by the market, prompting the company to raise its borrowing target to $40 million from an earlier planned $20 million.
Thai Chrysler has said it expects to nearly double its Thai vehicle sales to over 7,000 units in 1997.
